neo4jScheme.description: Neo4j driver URI scheme. `+s` encrypts with full certificate validation; `+ssc` encrypts and accepts self-signed certificates.

scheme.title: Connection Scheme
scheme.description: Neo4j driver URI scheme. Use `neo4j+s` for Neo4j Aura.

hostPort.title: Host and Port
hostPort.description: Host and port of the Neo4j server, e.g. `localhost:7687`. The port can be omitted to use 7687.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username to connect to Neo4j. The user needs read access to the graph schema of the database.

databaseName.title: Database Name
databaseName.description: Neo4j database to extract metadata from. If left blank, the user's home database is used.

includeRelationships.title: Include Relationships
includeRelationships.description: Also ingest relationship types as tables in the `relationships` schema, with their properties as columns.

propertyFilterPattern.title: Property Filter Pattern
propertyFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude node and relationship properties (columns) that match the pattern, e.g. properties written back by graph algorithms.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

schemaFilterPattern.title: Default Schema Filter Pattern
schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude schemas that matches the pattern.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

tableFilterPattern.title: Default Table Filter Pattern
tableFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude tables that matches the pattern.
